reason: A read-only DeepSeek Harness dashboard for monitoring token consumption, estimated costs, cache metrics, request trends, and account balance.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中以只读方式展示会话与聚合 Token 用量、估算费用、缓存指标、请求趋势及账户余额。
summaries.en: A read-only DeepSeek Harness dashboard for viewing session and aggregate token usage, estimated costs, cache metrics, request trends, and account balance.

capabilities: Displays live session and aggregate token usage statistics
Calculates estimated token costs from usage records and model pricing
Reads account balance through a server-side billing proxy
Provides request, project, model, and trend views
